name: Animalism (Dark Ages) — Advanced — Gap of Ages

system.description:
An advanced kin to Feral Speech, this power exerts such great conditioning upon natural beasts that the effects pass down through the generations. Affected animals and their descendants roam the wilds of Europe with a singular instruction burned into their minds, most often serving as guides who lead travelers of a certain "smell" (Nosferatu, in this case) along a specific path — though not all commands are altruistic.

System: Talking to an animal requires no roll, but to condition the creature and its descendants the player must succeed at a Manipulation + Animal Ken roll (difficulty 7). The commands must be as simple as the animal itself ("Bring others who smell like me through this path" or "Attack anyone who smells dead but continues walking"). Successes determine how many generations obey (1: two generations; 2: three; 3: four; 4: five; 5+: the family-line is eternally bound). Conditioning can be broken if another vampire uses this Discipline to issue new instructions; already-born offspring of a newly commanded animal are unaffected.

Costs 25 Experience Traits to learn.

MET: Win a Static Social Challenge (retest Animal Ken) to permanently condition an animal and its line of descendants to obey one simple standing instruction; the number of Traits bid determines how many generations remain bound.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Two: Lepers
